usedFor: Shopify holds products, and Cincopa holds media galleries, so “New Product” can start one with “Create Gallery”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Gallery” in Cincopa
bestTemplate.why: Every new product gets a gallery ready for photos and video.

watchOut: “Create Gallery” only makes the gallery, so “Upload Asset to Gallery” is a separate step for adding media.
